scope: Resource-bounded first-stage closeout; the full twelve-history/stress protocol remains separately unresolved.
selection_basis: Index0 is the first declared production representative. Initial60 breadth uses all twelve representatives plus every distinct predeclared minimum-a stress index. No Sharpe, regret, rank-change or slope is used to choose which full history is run.
resource_observation: First full high-rank replay and fitting exceeds twenty minutes locally; sixteen full histories would require several additional CPU hours. The remaining first-stage checks therefore use initial60 breadth, saved-coefficient paired quadrature, and explicit unrun full-horizon cells.
